poor.quote: Some green chaos whirled around me
Quiet and deserted, and yet I hear something there, beyond my wall.
And yet there, behind my wall, something is there.

good.quote: my eyes drowned in it as in the sea and looked for something to hold on to
It was so quiet that I grew ashamed of the pounding of my own heart.
Ten black rooms, filled to the brim with darkness. They lay siege to my room.
as though afraid the lamplight might all leak out through the cracks
everything would suddenly leap into its place
all those who left their faces in the mirrors, their voices in the cracks and corners
It filled the whole yard, hid in the trees, lay over the deep blue distances.
